company.name: Torq Labs
company.shortDescription: Torq Labs offers AI-powered smart clothing with sensors that monitor joint load, prevent injuries, and optimize athlete performance.
company.description:
Torq Labs is a Sports Technology company operating in the USA and the EU specializing in Multi-Sensor Wearable Technology to improve return to play processes for professional trainers and coaches to better train athletes and maintain performance and safety.   Torq Smart Clothing uses up to 10 lightweight, wireless, IMU sensors to collect and analyze athlete performance,  rehabilitation progress, and maintaining proper stability and balance in strength training.  

Torq Labs aims to bring Multi-Sensor wearable technologies to elite sports, strength training, and rehabilitation industries.
